rule: Merged entries: merged, no recorded rework, one per project, with a stated basis. The closure is the one whose reason changed a rule.

closure.quote: Sending non-real issues is not useful and not ethical.
closure.happened: The failing input came from the factory probing the code, not from anyone using the project. The account said so in the thread. Two later pull requests were closed for the same lack of a real case.
closure.changed: A candidate must name who hits the problem, with a source. Since 2026-11-10 a separate agent decides build, propose or drop before any code is written.
